name: beeadhoc-core
description: BeeAdHoc, the honeybee-inspired MANET routing protocol of Wedde & Farooq (2005), as PG 460's Linux module specifies it: a simulator-agnostic C++23 core (scouts, forager arrays rated by battery, swarms, a versioned source-route trailer, link failure; CMake package beeadhoc-core) and the ns-3 contrib module beeadhoc, on swarm-core.
